laws.o: قرار نقل خدمات العمالة المنزلية دون موافقة صاحب العمل
laws.tp: residence/sponsorship: Domestic workers. 12 cases for transfer without consent (e.g. 3 unpaid wages, no residence permit within 30 days, hiring out, dangerous work, abuse, employer stalling complaint or absent, contract ended in probation); final exit at end of contract. Implemented by HRSD rules (2024), which still cite the 2013 regulation. Updates an earlier decision (number not confirmed)

laws.k: gcc|SA|Domestic Workers and Those in Their Position Regulation
laws.t: Domestic Workers and Those in Their Position Regulation
laws.o: لائحة العمالة المنزلية ومن في حكمها
laws.tp: domestic work: Domestic workers (14 occupations incl. home farmer, home guard, private driver). Replaces CoM Decision 310/1434; in force one year after issue (c. Oct 2024). Min. age 21 (Art. 6); max 10 h/day, 8 h continuous rest (Art. 10); 1 weekly rest day (Art. 11); 30 days leave per 2 years (Art. 12); sick leave 15 full + 15 half pay (Art. 13); employer bears recruitment costs, no passport retention (Art. 15); end-of-service 1 month per 4 years (Art. 22); worker may end contract with rights for abuse/breach (Art. 27); fines up to SAR 20,000 (Art. 29). Silent on freedom of association
laws.s2: Berlaku bagi pekerja rumah tangga (14 jenis pekerjaan, termasuk sopir dan tukang kebun). Umur minimum 21 tahun, kerja paling lama 10 jam sehari, dan satu hari libur seminggu.

coded.vl: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
coded.n: Labour Law art. 7 excludes domestic workers; they are governed by the Domestic Workers Regulation (MD 40676/1445, published October 2023, in force 2024), which replaces MD 310/1434.
coded.src: Labour Law (M/51, 2005) art. 7; Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required, no language rule
coded.n: Contract on the ministry's mandatory templates; Arabic text prevails, with a translation into the worker's language; one year by default. The contract is valid even if not in writing, and no copy to the worker is required; Musaned registration is required by ministry procedure.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: Monthly payment by ministry-approved methods, deductions capped at 25 per cent; digital-wallet payment compulsory for all domestic workers, phased in July 2024 to January 2026.
coded.src: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 arts 17-20; HRSD

coded.vl: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
coded.n: At most 10 hours' work a day, at least 8 consecutive hours' rest and a break of at least 30 minutes after five hours; longer than the 8-hour norm under the Labour Law.

coded.vl: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
coded.n: One paid rest day a week.
30 days' paid leave after every two years if the contract is renewed (the Labour Law gives 21 days a year).

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
coded.n: The employer may not keep the worker's passport or personal documents.

coded.vl: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
coded.n: Suitable housing and food (or a cash allowance), and the right to contact family, embassy and authorities; no rule on privacy.

coded.vl: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: Transfer without the employer's consent in 12 listed cases (e.g. three unpaid wages, no residence permit, being hired out, dangerous work, abuse, employer's delay in a complaint); final exit at the end of the contract. No general right to change employer; the 2021 labour reforms exclude domestic workers.
coded.src: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 27; MD 212875/1443; HRSD rules on the contractual relationship (2024) art. 5(3)

coded.vl: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
coded.n: The employer bears recruitment costs and fees; recruitment companies may not take any sum from the worker or receive payments outside the Musaned platform.
coded.src: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 15(1); Recruitment Rules, MD 119698 (2025) arts 42, 50

coded.vl: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
coded.n: Recruitment companies are licensed with bank guarantees (SAR 2-10 million by category) that the ministry may draw on for unpaid worker dues or return costs; the licensee is liable for the worker it placed and must house absent workers; replacement or refund during the 90-day probation.
coded.src: Recruitment Rules, MD 119698 (2025) arts 8, 13, 46, 49, 53, 59; Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 9

coded.n: The regulation gives no power to inspect households; enforcement is complaint-based.

coded.vl: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
coded.n: Complaints to the ministry, which seeks an amicable settlement; claims lapse after 12 months.

coded.vl: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
coded.n: 30 days' sick leave a year (15 at full pay, 15 at half pay); end-of-service award of one month's wage per four years; health insurance under the 2024 framework; no maternity leave.

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.n: Violence, harassment, forced labour and trafficking prohibited; employer fines up to SAR 20,000 and/or a recruitment ban.
No provision in the regulation; migrant workers may not join workers' committees.
coded.src: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445; CoM Decree 12/1422

dec.n: Domestic worker’s claim for years of unpaid wages
dec.pe: A Sri Lankan domestic worker said she had not been paid for over a decade. A court in Hail ordered the employer to pay her wages and her flight home.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga asal Sri Lanka mengaku tidak digaji lebih dari sepuluh tahun. Pengadilan di Hail memerintahkan majikan membayar upahnya dan tiket pulangnya.

dec.n: Workers’ wage claims against Saudi Oger
dec.pe: Tens of thousands of workers of many nationalities at Saudi Oger went months without pay. Labour judgments in their favour were sent to the execution court, which ordered payment and moved to seize company assets.
dec.pi: Puluhan ribu pekerja berbagai kebangsaan di Saudi Oger tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Putusan perburuhan yang memenangkan mereka dikirim ke pengadilan eksekusi, yang memerintahkan pembayaran dan mulai menyita aset perusahaan.

dec.n: Staff wage claims against a contracting company owner
dec.pe: Workers of a contracting company had not been paid for months. A labour court told the owner to pay them or face arrest.
dec.pi: Pekerja sebuah perusahaan kontraktor tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Pengadilan perburuhan memerintahkan pemiliknya membayar atau menghadapi penangkapan.
